blocks.text: 1. Ancient History: Time period starts from earliest times to 7th Century AD.
2. Medieval History: Time period starts from 8th Century AD to 18th Century AD, which is the start of Islamic invasion.
3. Modern History: Time period starts from 18th Century AD onwards till now, which is the start of British Rule.
James Mill in his book "The History of British India" (1817), divided Indian History into three parts: Hindu, Muslim and British.

Neolithic People owned property.
Late Neolithic settlers were agriculturists who lived in circular (communal property) and rectangular (individual property) houses made of mud and pits, which is archaeologically attested.
Pottery: It was first invented in the neolithic period to store excess food grains (Cord impressed pottery).

Mehrgarh, 7000 BC (oldest neolithic site of Indian subcontinent in Balochistan, Pakistan): It provides evidence of early houses and the earliest traces of agriculture, with crops such as wheat, barley, and cotton cultivated here.
